description: Approval of details pursuant to conditions 8 (water efficiency) and 9 (renewable energy) of planning permission ref. P2021/2385/FUL dated 13 December 2022 (‘Erection of a two-bed dwellinghouse located to the rear garden including associated demolition of existing front garage, landscaping works, new 2m boundary fencing, construction of cycle storage, refuse/recycling storage and mobility scooter storage’).
decision_conditions: INFORMATIVE: You are advised that the design and installation of the Air Source Heat Pump hereby approved shall be such that when operating the cumulative noise level LAeq Tr arising from the proposed plant, measured or predicted at 1m from the facade of the nearest noise sensitive premises, shall not exceed a rating level of 42dBA. The measurement and/or prediction of the noise should be carried out in accordance with the methodology contained within the Microgeneration Certification Scheme Planning Standards. It is also advised to check the ASHP upon installation and ensure that it is regularly checked, maintained and serviced to ensure noise levels do not rise or acoustic character such as tonality, intermittency, impulsivity or other acoustic character develop.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
